summary.claim: Current selected evidence complete; observation credibility and scope need judgment

observations.expected: After a fresh editor reopen Body, Health and Pulse remain authored and state/definition assignments are inspectable.
observations.actual: Body, Eyes, OtherEye, Health and Pulse persisted. Inspector Health remained 3; state and shared definition assignments were visible.

observations.expected: Hit left changes only left health; pause/menu/resume through real input leaves hit count unchanged; gameplay resumes.
observations.actual: First hit produced left=2/right=3/hits=1. Resume kept left=2/right=3/hits=1. Following hit produced left=1/hits=2. Third hit defeated left while right stayed 3.

observations.expected: Inspector health set from three to five in a saved/reopened variant changes hits-to-defeat to five; the second enemy remains independent.
observations.actual: Reopened Inspector Health was 5. Runtime started left=5/right=3; after three hits left=2; after four left=1; fifth defeated left. Right stayed 3 throughout. Baseline defeated on third hit.

limit: Shared 2D fixture only; no real-game, 3D or target certification.
